body:
ina: Heads-up: multi-tenant recompute flagged by telemetry for 2026-04-02 11:00-12:30 UTC. Several customers showing missing agg rows after a late Kafka partition append. We should do a scoped recompute per-tenant to avoid blasting quotas.

ben: which tenants and shards? can we run per-tenant preflight?

ina: tenants: acme-inc, beta-studios, cafe-zero. Shards involved: 7, 8, 9. Rough raw rows across tenants ~420k but many will dedupe; risk is burst quota on Dedicated.

marta: prefer per-tenant preflight + dry-run. Console should provide a "dry-run cap" so ops can refuse runs above a token threshold. Also show an estimated impact on shared burst capacity.

leah: UX note: add a per-tenant slider in the replay modal with estimates and an "auto-split" toggle that runs tenants sequentially to limit peak burst.

ryan: infra note: priority lanes map to dedicated-burst (fast) and shared-spot (slower). fallback path currently preserves headers but doesn't propagate X-KV-Cache-Tag which means cache warmups are lost on fallback causing extra tokens. We should forward X-KV-Cache-Tag as well.

ina: good catch. that explains some token variance. can we patch router to copy X-KV-Cache-Tag on fallback?

ryan: yes, i'll add middleware to copy both X-Idempotency-Key and X-KV-Cache-Tag when routing falls back. small change + test.

quota-bot: preflight queued by ina at 1795553340. API: POST /replay/preflight body {tenants:["acme-inc","beta-studios","cafe-zero"], shards:[7,8,9], window:[2026-04-02T11:00Z..2026-04-02T12:30Z]}

quota-bot: preflight results (auto): acme-inc -> tokens 72.3k, est_duplicates 8.1k; beta-studios -> tokens 41.5k, est_duplicates 3.9k; cafe-zero -> tokens 15.2k, est_duplicates 1.2k; total_tokens=129k; slot_seconds=2100.

ben: total 129k is above soft limit. we should either split runs or use quota_override but that'll affect Dedicated burst. Console should refuse auto-run unless "allow quota override" is checked and on-call approves.

marta: propose sequential runs with auto-split: run acme-inc first (largest) with dedupe then beta then cafe. This keeps peak below 80k tokens. Ops prefers sequential to avoid single large burst.

leah: UI plan: add "sequential per-tenant run" option with estimated per-step tokens and a checkbox for "require on-call approval if any step > 80k tokens". Also surface a note about KV cache tag propagation.

ops-bot: dry-run for acme-inc scheduled by ben at 1795553355: `/replay run --tenant acme-inc --shards 7,8,9 --mode dry-run --since 2026-04-02T11:00Z --until 2026-04-02T12:30Z`

ops-bot: dry-run complete: acme-inc duplicates=8,050; token_estimate=71,900; schema_validation=ok; kv_cache_hit_rate_low=true

ina: kv_cache_hit_rate_low = we'll warm the cache first. Plan: (1) warm KV cache for acme-inc prefix keys (fast run) (2) run deduped replay for acme-inc (3) repeat for others. warming should reduce tokens by ~12-18%.

ryan: I'll add header passthrough for X-KV-Cache-Tag in router PR tonight. Also adding a lightweight warmup endpoint /replay/warm-cache that accepts tenant + shard list.

ben: I'll own handoff. Plan: warm cache -> dedupe replay acme-inc -> wait 10m -> run beta-studios -> run cafe-zero. Will require on-call if any step > 80k tokens.

ops-bot: cache-warm job started (id cw-20260402-11). estimated time 90s.

ops-bot: cache-warm complete. estimated token savings ~15%. updated acme-inc token estimate=61k.

ben: acme-inc live replay start in 5. command: `/replay run --tenant acme-inc --shards 7,8,9 --dedupe --mode live --quota-override 70k --route priority:dedicated-burst`

ops-bot: replay job started id r-20260402-400. routing: dedicated-burst -> fallback shared-spot.

leah: monitoring dashboards: watch dedicated pool usage, per-tenant token burn, and route fallback rate. I'll post if fallback rate > 2% or if latency >2x baseline.

ops-bot: mid-run alert: route fallback occurred for short window (0.9% of requests) due to transient slot contention; router preserved X-Idempotency-Key and X-KV-Cache-Tag. no dupes.

ben: good. continue.

ops-bot: acme-inc job finished. tokens_used=60,910; duplicates_removed=7,992; fallback_rate=0.9%; no SLO breaches.

ben: waiting 10m, then starting beta-studios dry-run now to confirm numbers. `/replay run --tenant beta-studios --shards 7,8,9 --mode dry-run`

ops-bot: dry-run complete beta-studios: duplicates=3,880; token_estimate=40.2k; kv_cache_hit_rate_medium

ben: proceed with live for beta-studios with dedupe no override (estimate 40.2k). starting now.

ops-bot: beta-studios job finished. tokens_used=40,030; duplicates_removed=3,840; no SLOs.

ben: lastly cafe-zero live run. small one.

ops-bot: cafe-zero job finished. tokens_used=14,980; duplicates_removed=1,210.

ina: overall totals: tokens_used=116k (after warmups & dedupe), duplicates removed ~13k. Good job. Follow-ups: (1) console: implement sequential per-tenant run + dry-run cap + explicit on-call approval flow (leah), (2) router: PR for X-KV-Cache-Tag propagation (ryan), (3) add cache-warm example to runbook and a recommended 10m gap between tenant steps (marta).

leah: will draft the mock with sequential UI and "auto-warm cache" toggle and post link in ~2h.

ryan: router PR opened and tests added. will roll tomorrow to staging.

marta: I'll update the runbook with this example and the verification query to compare per-tenant aggregates and flag >0.5% divergence.

ina: thanks team. filing a short incident note in #postmortems with the recompute summary. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
